text:
maria: quick heads-up — bringing up kenai-13b (int4) for hosted canary. initial perf looks ok but seeing a consistent quality regression on long-form QA and intermittent OOMs once batch_size > 4. dumping notes here, pls react. :white_flag:

sam: ugh. can you paste the OOM log? and current defaults (max_new_tokens, prefetch, kv reserve)?

maria: paste below. stack shows kv cache growth then evict fail. defaults we used for canary: max_new_tokens=512, batch_size=8, prefetch=true, kv_reserve_mb=0.

```
[E 14:02:11] oom: alloc failed in kv_cache_alloc -> evict_failed
[E 14:02:11] req_id=rc_81f: prefetch_alloc=512MB, kv_used=1.2GB, total_alloc=14.7GB
[W 14:02:11] fallback: started model-fallback check to int8-compat
```

jin: two things to try short term: 1) reduce max_new_tokens default to 128 for this model family; 2) disable/trim prefetch window (prefetch=false or prefetch_window=32). both reduce peak working set.

oliver: also consider kv_reserve_mb=256 to avoid fragmentation + slot reservation (reserve_slots=2) to keep a small hot cache. we've seen that help for other 13b int4s.

lisa: question on the quality regression — is it from quantization (int4) or from config (prefetch+batching)? any eval diffs?

maria: ran quick eval on our long-form QA eval set (1000 prompts). numbers: baseline fp16 canary -> EM 78.4, Rouge-L 67.2. int4 with current defaults -> EM 72.6, Rouge-L 63.4. so ~5.8 pt EM drop, pretty material.

sam: that's significant. can you run a micro-ablations? int4 + no prefetch, int4 + lower max_new, int4 + kv_reserve? small runs with 200 prompts each should surface.

maria: running now. will post numbers in ~30m.

[triage-bot]: alert: canary error rate spike on kenai-13b-int4 at 2026-03-20T14:05:12Z (5xx rate -> 4.2%)

maria: quick interim: int4 + prefetch=false + max_new_tokens=128 -> EM 75.5, Rouge-L 65.1. int4 + prefetch=false + max_new_tokens=128 + kv_reserve_mb=256 -> EM 76.2, Rouge-L 65.6.

jin: interesting — turning off prefetch recovered ~3 pts EM, reserve gave +0.7. suggests quality impact mostly from prefetch interacting with KV alignment/eviction path, not quantization arithmetic.

oliver: memory fragmentation may cause requests to hit a cold eviction path mid-generation which could drop partial context or cause tokenizer truncation in rare cases 🤔. reserve helps smooth it.

lisa: any latency/regression tradeoffs? lowering max_new_tokens and disabling prefetch both affect throughput/latency.

maria: perf notes from canary:
- before: p50=210ms, p95=650ms, tokens/sec=4200
- int4 (defaults): p50=190ms, p95=720ms, tokens/sec=4600 (but many 5xxs)
- int4 + prefetch=false + max_new=128 + kv_reserve=256: p50=195ms, p95=690ms, tokens/sec=4400, 5xxs ~0.4%

sam: so small hit on peak throughput but big win on stability + quality. sounds acceptable for initial rollout.

maria: proposing a short-term canary patch to model-config:
```json
{
  "model":"kenai-13b-int4",
  "defaults":{
    "max_new_tokens":"128",
    "prefetch":"false",
    "kv_reserve_mb":"256",
    "reserve_slots":"2",
    "slow_start_pct":"10"
  }
}
```

jin: add slow_start_pct=10 to ramp traffic and avoid cold mass churn. also add canary routing rule -> prefer int8 fallback for requests with tokens > 256.

oliver: we should also add an automated quality check on long-form QA eval after any config change; link canary to regen evals. small script exists: /eng-ml/tools/longform-eval.sh

maria: opened PR with patch + smoke test: PR 5832. dropping note to infra to schedule a 10% canary with those defaults.

[triage-bot]: deploy-plan: kenai-13b-int4-config-patch -> canary 10% -> 24h metrics -> promote if 5xx<1% and EM drop <2.0 (vs fp16 baseline)

sam: one more: please capture an allocation profile (jemalloc stats) before/after reserve to validate fragmentation reduction. if we can show free-list churn down, that’s good evidence.

maria: will capture and attach. early jemalloc snapshot shows active_arena_frag ~18% -> after reserve ~9% (prelim).

lisa: leaving a note for docs: update model onboarding checklist to include prefetch-sensitivity test and kv_reserve trial for int4 models.

maria: thanks all — rolling patch to canary in 15m. will post final numbers after 24h run. :thumbsup:
